readiness.purpose: Algebra I prerequisite planning and course-entry evidence

lesson_mastery.rule: Lesson completion alone does not unlock progression; numeric mastery evidence at or above 80% is required.

weekly_mastery.selection: week-specific depth bank balanced across lesson coverage
weekly_mastery.prerequisite_policy: Readiness must be mastered; assigned lessons for the week must be mastered; prior graded weekly mastery must be met; Week 19 also requires reviewed Midterm mastery.

unit_mastery.retry_policy: Fixed-form retries retain prior attempts; missed work is corrected and the same mastery form may be retried.
unit_mastery.prerequisites: All unit lessons and all instructional weekly mastery checks assigned to the unit must be at or above 80% before unit mastery can authorize progression.

midterm.prerequisite_policy: Units 01-06 must have complete lesson, weekly, and unit mastery evidence at or above 80%.

final.prerequisite_policy: All 13 units must have complete lesson, weekly, and unit mastery evidence at or above 80%, and the Midterm must be mastered.

trust.storage: browser-local with verified-write adapter when available
trust.official_credit: determined by the parent, teacher, school, or authorized evaluator from retained evidence

note: The legacy base question-bank count does not include all supplemental depth-bank questions used by current weekly and unit mastery surfaces.
